findings.title: FMEA I-5 (R10) and R10_VALIDATION §1 name the 3V3 over-voltage clamp 'H-9', but the FMEA's H-9 is the load-switch gate-source capacitor (fitted on R10 as C120)
findings.contradicts: docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md §4.2 (line 385): 'H-9 — A 1 µF/50 V 0603 (C15849, zero new part numbers) from GATE_SW to the common-source node (not to ground). +1 part, rated "consider".' and docs/R2_VERIFICATION.md line 108: '| H-9 gate-source capacitor on the load switch | Done (C120 2.2 µF) |'. The FMEA change list (§4, H-1 ... H-10) defines no 3V3 clamp or crowbar.
findings.evidence: Committed text at 816038c: docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 37 (I-5 (R10) row, current R10 disposition): 'Respin options: a 3V3 over-voltage clamp or crowbar (H-9), In2 3V3 ≥ 1 mm or GND-guarded from RAW_PROTECTED, ...'; docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2406 (§1 (a)/(b), owner-facing): 'Respin options: a 3V3 over-voltage clamp or crowbar (the FMEA's optional H-9), ...'. The label comes from the original I-5 row, docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 111: 'Optional H-9 (3.6 V clamp on 3V3, which fails short = board dies on the bench)', which already disagrees with the same file's §4.2 definition of H-9. On board a0ec075e… the item H-9 describes is fitted: C120 (1 µF 25 V X7R) from ACT_GATE (C120.2, B(17.1,73.3)) to ACT_FET_S (C120.1, B(17.1,71.75)), the Q120 / Q121 gate-source capacitor that AGENTS §2.4 requires. git grep 'H-9' finds no other definition.
findings.impact: The I-5 respin option (the only hardware remedy the records give for the battery-or-port-voltage-onto-3V3 fire class) points the owner at an FMEA item that is a different part, already fitted on R10 and recorded 'Done'. A reader who follows the reference can conclude the clamp is a one-0603 change or is already implemented; the clamp/crowbar itself is defined and analysed nowhere in the FMEA change list. No board or procedure change follows.
findings.concrete_fix: In docs/FMEA_REDUNDANCY.md line 37 replace '(H-9)' and in docs/R10_VALIDATION.md line 2406 replace '(the FMEA's optional H-9)' with '(not an FMEA change-list item: the original I-5 row calls a 3.6 V 3V3 clamp "H-9", but §4.2's H-9 is the load-switch gate-source capacitor, fitted on R10 as C120)'. Annotate line 111's 'Optional H-9' as a mislabel for the 3.6 V 3V3 clamp (historical row; §4.2's H-9 is the GATE_SW capacitor).

observations: Independent fire-chain audit (18 pyro / arming / gate / sense nets against every net, four layers, fills and unflashed barrels) on a0ec075e reproduces every §1 / owner-row / FMEA figure: OUT-GND 0.1768 / 0.1800 mm, R173.1-Q124 source via 0.5000, R173.1-R162.1 (BUZZ_DRV) 0.7935, R173.1-BUZZ_G 0.5100, CONT_MID-BUZZ_G 0.1750 (diagonal 0.2005), CONT_MID-R134.2 0.2500 (diagonal 0.387), R173.2-D120.3 0.4154, R173.2-R162.1 1.1328, ARM1_SENSE-U13.5 0.1500, RAW_ACT-GND 0.3162 (pads / tracks / vias), EN-node pairs 0.200 / 0.330 / 0.500 / 0.5197 mm.

Two bus-to-3V3 pairs lie outside the records' 0.6 mm inventory band: PYRO1_IGN-3V3 0.7359 mm (R134.1 to the 3V3 via (15.7,61.6), B.Cu) and RAW_ACT-3V3 0.8370 mm (R132.1 to the 3V3 via (28.1,59.4), B.Cu); with PC1 high each puts bus voltage onto 3V3 through at most 2 Ω (the I-5 mechanism, Inference) but drives no match current (both match ends rise together); members of the disclosed I-5 class (owner row 1 says 'include'), not enumerated, and nearer than the 1.040 mm D-R26-02 holds for the OUT members.

Other I-5 members the route lists do not enumerate (non-exhaustive, round 22 safety listed most): In2 barrels 0.2505 mm inside the opposite fill (3V3 via (26.4,79.26) in RAW_PROTECTED; VLOGIC (34.5,62.4), CAM_5V (34.2,49.325), VBUS (7.95,27.9) vias and the In2 USB_LIMITED track in the 3V3 fill), U2.1-U2.2 (3V3-VLOGIC) 0.400 mm, U9.4-U9.5 (BAT_FAULT_N-BAT_IN) 0.200 mm; the stated fill-to-fill gaps (3V3 to RAW_PROTECTED / PORT_5V3 / PORT_4V8) are 0.300 mm as recorded.
PE4's net is 1.369 mm from the IMU_INT1 track (17.5,48.36)-(18.21,47.65), F.Cu under U1 behind mask: a push-pull 3.3 V output, the QSPI_IO2 row's class, beyond the 1.2 mm audit band.

D-R26-04 audit: my whole-board comparison with 3d8e845's board reproduces its seven rows exactly without fills and six with fills (BUZZ_DRV/PYRO1_OUT 0.9635 -> 0.7935). Per-layer views add drops that leave every net-pair minimum unchanged (3V3/I2C1_SDA F.Cu 1.168 -> 0.802 at R13's moved via vs the I2C via (9.97,51.5); BUZZ_DRV/GND inner barrels 0.907 -> 0.524; new AUX/GND at J440), so the per-pair list is complete by its own definition; none is pyro.

Pair count under 1.2 mm with fills: 775 by my extractor (744 flashed copper only; 542 / 511 without the unconnected-pin nets) against D-R26-04's 711: method-dependent; no statement or conclusion depends on it.
§1's 'least RAW_ACT-to-GND gap is 0.316 mm' keeps the preceding sentence's pad / track / via scope; the B.Cu GND fill is 0.2505 mm from RAW_ACT (22.8,61.4)-(26.17,58.03).

Owner row 24's 0.5205 / 0.5008 mm (ACT_EN_MCU / RAW_ACT to BAT_ENABLE) against exact 0.5197 / 0.5000 mm (the §1 table gives 0.500): KiCad circle polygonization, under 1 µm; no conclusion depends on it.

ACT_DRV-ACT_EN (Q122.3-Q122.1, 1.044 mm): R123 then pulls ACT_GATE through R121 (VGS about -6 V), so the bus comes on with J400 open and PC1 low; row 2's load-switch / PC1-enable class; per-flight step 2 (J121.2 < 0.1 V) screens it before the e-match.

ACT_EN_MCU-RAW_PROTECTED 0.8266 mm (PC1's F.Cu run to the via (24.3,66.0)) and ACT_EN_MCU-USB_LIMITED 0.670 mm (via (25.6,63.0)) enable Q122 whenever PC1 is not driven and over-drive the PC1 pin; row 2 class; the cold screen's bus-live refusal and step 6 apply.

BAT_IN-RAW_PROTECTED at U9.5-U9.6 (0.200 mm) and the BAT_IN via (17.5,87.15) barrel 0.2505 mm from In2 RAW_PROTECTED turn the board on with J400 open (round 25 safety observation 3); per-flight step 2 screens the symptom.
U9.1-U9.2 (EN-OVLO, 0.200 mm): with J400 open EN = 8.4 V x (280 k || 300 k) / (2 M + 145 k) = 0.57 V, no turn-on; with J400 closed OVLO trips (about 1.55 V): fail-safe.
BAT_SW_SOURCE via (10.8,69.2) and J400.1's In2 ring 0.2505 mm from In2 RAW_PROTECTED / GND: no turn-on or latch (470 kΩ path; an open J400 separates it from EN); a short holds EN low: fail-safe.

AGENTS §2 on the board as built: Q124 R126 220 Ω / R128 10 kΩ / C126 220 nF (plus R127 1 kΩ at PE4); Q120 / Q121 R121 10 kΩ / R119 || R120 50 kΩ / C120 1 µF; Q122 R122 1 kΩ / R123 2 kΩ / C123 10 nF; RAW_ACT is reached only through Q121; S-1 ... S-9 pass on a copy with the project files.
AON7524 VGS(th) is 0.4-1.2 V with RDS(on) < 5.8 mΩ at 2.5 V (AOS datasheet p2), so the 3.23 V gate-net bridge and the 1.19-1.98 V QSPI_IO2 fight fire an enabled match as the records state.

The load switch's 'worst-case settled |VGS| 4.74 V' uses parts_budget's 6.0 V minimum loaded BAT_IN (the pad check); the same formula at the fire budget's four-stall 5.713 V gives about 4.60 V with the 1.28 A fire current (4.50 V with the budget's 4.2 A term), still at the -4.5 V RDS(on) point; the fire budget already takes 40 mΩ per FET.

REQUIREMENTS F6 'No sensor, bus or loop failure may block deployment' against F8 / firmware rule 1 'with the barometer invalid the primary channel does not fire': F6 reads as a software-robustness clause (no blocking I/O), and AGENTS §2.1 requires the barometer.

Cold-screen arithmetic reproduced: healthy 99.37 / 99.34 mV, open 146.23 / 0 mV (Vf 0.20 V); OUT-3V3 0.295 V; CONT_MID-RAW_ACT with an open match 102.0 / 55.5 mV (Vf 0.30 V) and with an intact match about 139 / 76 mV, both out of band.
Rule 8 corner reproduced from the budget equation V = 7.4 - 0.15 (V / R + 7.68 + 13.064 / V): 5.7132 / 5.5576 / 5.5555 / 5.5085 V.
C10's Fab / pad envelope is 3.0166 mm from U5's pad-extent corner (12.78,51.15): the whole-part coat selection stands as ORDERING 8.3 says.
M3_R10's 'within the FT limit of VDD + 4 V' follows DS12110 Rev 8 Table 119 (Rev 11 adds a 6 V cap; 4.6 V is within both); PC14 is FT in the Rev 8 pin table.
